name: onchain-desk-brief
description: Cited on-chain desk brief for one EVM wallet or one protocol — Alchemy token-by-address (x402 via Circle Gateway; verify prints routed-x402), Dune SQL execute (MPP on Tempo), SELAT-native Twitter chatter (x402 via Circle Gateway; verify prints routed-x402). Paid per call via selat-pay (USDC via Circle Gateway).

address.description: EVM wallet or protocol-token/contract address for the Alchemy token-by-address step (used as ${address}). Always pass the user's 0x address explicitly when they gave a wallet.

protocol.description: Protocol or token name used to retarget twitter_query and sql. Not interpolated into a URL by itself.

sql.description: Dune SQL for POST /api/v1/sql/execute (used as ${sql}). Verify uses SELECT 1 so the live 402 is exercisable. Rewrite to the named wallet or protocol before a paid run.

twitter_query.description: SELAT-native Twitter advanced-search query (used as ${twitter_query}). Widen with protocol, token ticker, or a known wallet label — not a raw 0x dump.

steps.label: twitter chatter — SELAT-native advanced search (x402 via Circle Gateway)
on-chain token footprint — Alchemy token-by-address (x402 via Circle Gateway)
on-chain SQL — Dune sql/execute (MPP on Tempo)
